say:1:1422004001:0.text: Jim and Duluth, where have you been? I was just about to go look for you!
say:1:1422004001:0.source_cn: 吉姆，德鲁斯，你们回来啦，我正要去找你们呢！

say:3:1422004002:0.text: We just went out for some fresh air... Heh, I think I'm getting a bit tipsy.
say:3:1422004002:0.source_cn: 我们就是去外面透透气……呵呵，刚刚有点喝多了。

say:4:1422004003:0.text: Tipsy? We're just warming up! Try this one—
say:4:1422004003:0.source_cn: 喝多？这才哪到哪！来尝尝这款——

say:5:1422004004:0.text: Hey, look who we brought! Zanie, and her Lightbearer mage friend!
say:5:1422004004:0.source_cn: 看我们把谁带回来了！祖娅，还有她的耀光魔法师朋友！
say:5:1422004004:0.male: Hey, look who we brought! Zanie, and her Lightbearer mage friend!
say:5:1422004004:0.female: Hey, look who we brought! Zanie, and her Lightbearer mage friend!

say:7:1422004005:0.text: What a pleasure, Zanie! You were still a little girl the last time I saw you! You really haven't changed a bit...
say:7:1422004005:0.source_cn: 哎呀，祖娅！上次见你的时候我还是个小年轻呢，你果然像他...

say:8:1422004006:0.text: Are you the Lightbearer mage? What an honor!
say:8:1422004006:0.source_cn: 这位就是耀光魔法师？这可稀罕了。
say:8:1422004006:0.male: Are you the Lightbearer mage? What an honor!
say:8:1422004006:0.female: Are you the Lightbearer mage? What an honor!

say:9:1422004007:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> sure knows a lot about drinks, having traveled far and wide! Have you been into brewing lately, Lavas? Dazzle us with your blends!
say:9:1422004007:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> sure knows a lot about drinks, having traveled far and wide! Have you been into brewing lately, Lavas? Dazzle us with your blends!
say:9:1422004007:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> sure knows a lot about drinks, having traveled far and wide! Have you been into brewing lately, Lavas? Dazzle us with your blends!

say:10:1422004008:0.text: Maybe he could give you some pointers!
say:10:1422004008:0.male: Maybe he could give you some pointers!
say:10:1422004008:0.female: Maybe she could give you some pointers!

choice_prompt:11:1422004008.source_cn: 说不定<male>他</male><female>她</female>还能指导指导你，给你一些建议！

choice_prompt:11:1422004008.female: Maybe she could give you some pointers!

say:12:1422004009:0.text: Great, I could really use your help! Let me show you my invention—the Furnace Brewer!
say:12:1422004009:0.source_cn: 这可正合我意！来看看我的发明——熔炉酿造器！
say:12:1422004009:0.male: Great, I could really use your help! Let me show you my invention—the Furnace Brewer!
say:12:1422004009:0.female: Great, I could really use your help! Let me show you my invention—the Furnace Brewer!

say:13:1422004010:0.text: Isn't this just a storage tank... Wait, does it have an engine inside?
say:13:1422004010:0.source_cn: 这不就是个存储罐……不对，它内部有动力系统？

say:14:1422004011:1.text: It took a lot of hard work to create this machine! The engine inside speeds up fermentation and automates the entire brewing process! Brewing has never been simpler and quicker!
say:14:1422004011:1.source_cn: 这可是我苦心研制许久的成果，酿造器内部的动力系统持续供...

say:15:1422004012:0.text: I've also come up with a recipe that suits our taste. A drink will be ready soon!
say:15:1422004012:0.source_cn: 刚好我研究了一个符合矮人口味的新配方，算算时间酿造的差...

say:16:1422004013:0.text: Can this machine... make edible drinks?
say:16:1422004013:0.source_cn: 这机器……酿出的东西真的能喝？

say:17:1422004014:0.text: If you don't believe me, just take a look at the fine brew inside!
say:17:1422004014:0.source_cn: 不信你们来看看我酿造器里面的佳酿！
